items.source: By default, only same origin requests are allowed. Use setAllowedOrigins(Collection) to specify a list of allowed origins (a list containing "*" will allow all origins).
items.translation: 默认情况下，仅允许同源请求。使用setAllowedOrigins(Collection)指定允许的源列表（包含 "*" 的列表将允许所有源）。
HTTP 请求之间的时间间隔应相对较短，且不得超过允许的断开延迟（参见setDisconnectDelay(long)）；默认值为 5 秒。

items.source:
The SockJS protocol also expects a SockJS service to echo back the JSESSIONID
cookie when this property is set to true. However, when running in a Servlet
container this is not necessary since the container takes care of it.
items.translation: SockJS 协议还期望当此属性设置为 true 时，SockJS 服务会回显 JSESSIONID cookie。然而，在 Servlet 容器中运行时则不需要，因为容器会自动处理它。

items.source:
The default value is "true" to maximize the chance for applications to work
correctly in IE 8,9 with support for cookies (and the JSESSIONID cookie in
particular). However, an application can choose to set this to "false" if
the use of cookies (and HTTP session) is not required.
items.translation: 默认值为 "true"，以最大化应用程序在 IE 8、9 中配合 Cookie（特别是 JSESSIONID Cookie）支持正确运行的机会。然而，如果不需要使用 Cookie（和 HTTP 会话），应用程序可以选择将其设置为 "false"。

items.source:
This method determines the SockJS path and handles SockJS static URLs.
Session URLs and raw WebSocket requests are delegated to abstract methods.
items.translation: 此方法确定 SockJS 路径并处理 SockJS 静态 URL。会话 URL 和原始 WebSocket 请求已委托给抽象方法。

items.source: Handle request for raw WebSocket communication, i.e. without any SockJS message framing.
items.translation: 处理原始 WebSocket 通信的请求，即不使用任何 SockJS 消息封装。

items.source: Handle a SockJS session URL (i.e. transport-specific request).
items.translation: 处理 SockJS 会话 URL（即特定传输的请求）。

items.source: SockJsException - raised when request processing fails; generally, failed attempts to send messages to clients automatically close the SockJS session and raise SockJsTransportFailureException; failed attempts to read messages from clients do not automatically close the session and may result in SockJsMessageDeliveryException or SockJsException; exceptions from the WebSocketHandler can be handled internally or through ExceptionWebSocketHandlerDecorator or some alternative decorator. The former is automatically added when using SockJsHttpRequestHandler.
items.translation: SockJsException - 在请求处理失败时抛出；通常，向客户端发送消息的失败尝试会自动关闭 SockJS 会话并抛出SockJsTransportFailureException；从客户端读取消息的失败尝试不会自动关闭会话，并可能导致SockJsMessageDeliveryException 或SockJsException；来自 WebSocketHandler 的异常可以通过内部处理或通过ExceptionWebSocketHandlerDecorator 或某些替代装饰器进行处理。前者在使用SockJsHttpRequestHandler时会自动添加。

items.source: Note that it's possible to specify a relative URL in which case the URL must be relative to the iframe URL. For example assuming a SockJS endpoint mapped to "/sockjs", and resulting iframe URL "/sockjs/iframe.html", then the relative URL must start with "../../" to traverse up to the location above the SockJS mapping. In case of a prefix-based Servlet mapping one more traversals may be needed.
items.translation: 请注意，可以指定相对 URL，此时该 URL 必须相对于 `iframe` 的 URL。例如，假设 SockJS 端点映射到 "/sockjs"，生成的 `iframe` URL 为 "/sockjs/iframe.html"，则相对 URL 必须以 "../../" 开头，以便向上遍历到 SockJS 映射位置之上的目录。如果是基于前缀的 Servlet 映射，可能需要多进行一次遍历。

items.source: By default, no origins are allowed. When allowedOriginPatterns is also set, then that takes precedence over this property.
items.translation: 默认情况下，不允许任何源。当同时设置`allowedOriginPatterns`时，该属性优先于此属性。

items.source: By default this is set to point to "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/sockjs/1.0.0/sockjs.min.js". However, it can also be set to point to a URL served by the application.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此设置指向 "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/sockjs/1.0.0/sockjs.min.js"。不过，也可以将其设置为指向应用程序提供的 URL。

items.source: The default value is 128K (i.e. 128 * 1024).

This is especially important for IE 8,9 that support XDomainRequest -- a modified
AJAX/XHR -- that can do requests across domains but does not send any cookies. In
those cases, the SockJS client prefers the "iframe-htmlfile" transport over
"xdr-streaming" in order to be able to send cookies.
items.translation: 这对于支持 XDomainRequest（一种修改后的 AJAX/XHR，可跨域发送请求但不发送任何 Cookie）的 IE 8 和 IE 9 尤为重要。在这些情况下，SockJS 客户端首选 "iframe-htmlfile" 传输方式而非 "xdr-streaming"，以便能够发送 Cookie。

items.source: The default value is 25,000 (25 seconds).
The default value is 5000.
items.translation: 默认值为 5000。

items.source: The default size is 100.
items.translation: 默认大小为 100。

items.source: The default value is "true".
items.translation: 默认值为"true"。

items.source: The default value is "false".
items.translation: 默认值为"false"。

items.source:
Note when SockJS is enabled and origins are restricted, transport types
that do not allow to check request origin (Iframe based transports) are
disabled. As a consequence, IE 6 to 9 are not supported when origins are
restricted.
items.translation: 注意：当启用 SockJS 并限制源时，不允许检查请求源的传输类型（基于 iframe 的传输）将被禁用。因此，当限制源时，不支持 IE 6 到 9。

items.source: By default this is not set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此项未设置。

items.source: Alternative to setAllowedOrigins(Collection) that supports more flexible patterns for specifying the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser.
items.translation: 作为 `setAllowedOrigins(Collection)` 的替代方案，支持更灵活的浏览器跨域请求允许源模式。

items.source: Transports with no native cross-domain communication (for example, "eventsource", "htmlfile") must get a simple page from the "foreign" domain in an invisible iframe so that code in the iframe can run from a domain local to the SockJS server.
items.translation: 没有原生跨域通信功能的传输（例如，"eventsource"、"htmlfile"）必须从“外部”域获取一个简单的页面，并将其放置在不可见的iframe中，以便iframe中的代码可以从 SockJS 服务器本地的域运行。

Specify the amount of time in milliseconds when the server has not sent
any messages and after which the server should send a heartbeat frame
to the client in order to keep the connection from breaking.

for the next HTTP polling request from the client.
items.translation: 会话在等待客户端的下一个 HTTP 轮询请求时，可以缓存的服务器到客户端消息的数量。

items.source:
The SockJS protocol requires a server to respond to an initial "/info" request from
clients with a "cookie_needed" boolean property that indicates whether the use of a
JSESSIONID cookie is required for the application to function correctly, for example, for
load balancing or in Java Servlet containers for the use of an HTTP session.
items.translation: SockJS 协议要求服务器对客户端的初始 "/info" 请求做出响应，其中包含一个名为 "cookie_needed" 的布尔属性，该属性指示应用程序（例如用于负载均衡或在 Java Servlet 容器中用于使用 HTTP 会话）正常运行是否需要使用 JSESSIONID cookie。

items.source:
Streaming transports save responses on the client side and don't free
memory used by delivered messages.
items.translation: 流式传输传输会在客户端保存响应，并且不会释放已传递消息所使用的内存。
